description: Predicts wind and solar generation from weather and plant data.
body: Signature edition. Signature-original methods and framings for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Predicts wind and solar generation from weather and plant data. A renewable forecasting system blends NWP models, satellite cloud data, and plant SCADA with machine learning to predict generation from minutes to days ahead. Real implementations include vendor forecasters and open stacks (OpenOA). It quantifies uncertainty with probabilistic forecasts for market bidding.

title: Renewable Energy Forecasting System — Teaching-ladder exercise
t: Renewable Energy Forecasting System — Teaching-ladder exercise
description: Predicts wind and solar generation from weather and plant data.
body: Signature edition. Signature-original methods and framings for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Teaching ladder for Renewable Energy Forecasting System, simple to complex. Rank 1: name the tool's single core action (NWP downscaling to plant level). Rank 3: run it once on a tiny input and check the output. Rank 5: combine two capabilities: NWP downscaling to plant level and Satellite/cloud-motion very-short-term forecasts. Rank 7: chain its output into a neighboring tool (Power-grid stability simulator) with a verification checkpoint. Rank 9+: automate the full workflow and teach it to someone else.
capabilities: ML blending of models and SCADA
